# unifi_network_dns_record (Resource)

A local DNS record. Served from the v2 `/static-dns` surface today; routing moves to the Integration DNS surface on newer firmware with no schema change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A local A record resolved by the console's DNS.
resource "unifi_network_dns_record" "nas" {
  name  = "nas.lan"
  type  = "A"
  value = "10.0.30.10"
}

# A CNAME alias.
resource "unifi_network_dns_record" "files" {
  name  = "files.lan"
  type  = "CNAME"
  value = "nas.lan"
}

# An SRV record uses the extra port/priority/weight fields.
resource "unifi_network_dns_record" "sip" {
  name     = "_sip._tcp.lan"
  type     = "SRV"
  value    = "sip.lan"
  port     = 5060
  priority = 10
  weight   = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) DNS name (the record key), e.g. `host.example.com`.
- `value` (String) Record target (IP address, hostname, or text depending on type).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the record is active.
- `port` (Number) Port (SRV records).
- `priority` (Number) Priority (MX/SRV records).
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds; `0` (or unset) uses the controller default.
- `type` (String) Record type: `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `SRV`, or `NS`.
- `weight` (Number) Weight (SRV records).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Local DNS records import by their controller object ID (`_id`), the resource's `id`.
terraform import unifi_network_dns_record.nas 661f3a9c2b4d5e0012ab34cf
```
